description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called DebugSettings, which provides a user interface for diagnosing and debugging issues within an OpenClaw macOS application. It includes sections for gateway control, logs, port diagnostics, paths, quick actions, Canvas interactions, and experimental features. The file contains multiple properties, UI components, and methods to perform debugging tasks such as checking ports, restarting services, evaluating JavaScript in Canvas, and managing configuration paths.

classes.name: PlainSettingsGroupBoxStyle
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI style for consistent styling of GroupBoxes within the DebugSettings view.

methods.name: canvasSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the Canvas session and updates the snapshot path.
